messages.author: d9c0228d8965934f
messages.subject: Output Format
parts:
Hello all,

I am new to Rhadoop and have been trying to start with some basic programs of mapreduce using rmr2. However I have been unable to debug my programs because the output of the reducer is in the sequenced typedbytes format and I can't seem to figure out how to make it appear as text.

I have looked online for a solution and tried a few things, but cant see the output. Any pointers as to how should I go about it?

Apologies if this is a very basic question and I have missed out on an earlier post

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1887] Output Format
parts:
from.dfs can read that format into a convenient R data structure, for reasonable sized data. Seems like a better alternative to changing formats. Otherwise, the output.format argument to mapreduce and make.output.format are the places to start.


Antonio
